# Physics modes (menus 265 always, 269 on/off, 272 off), the playback ON/OFF
# override (menu 271) across two playbacks, and physics reset (menu 268).
settle 0
load pmm swing600.pmm
trace mode.trace
physics mode 1
pump 3 33
play 0 60
pump 10 33
stop
pump 1 33
physics playback toggle
play 0 60
pump 10 33
stop
pump 1 33
physics playback toggle
physics mode 2
pump 3 33
physics mode 0
pump 3 33
physics mode 2
physics reset
pump 3 33
save pmm mode.pmm
